items.q: But bwana, oh, boy. You forget that word. And they really mean it, too.

ctx.x: Master. That's what it means, master. But bwana, oh, boy. You forget that word. And they really mean it, too.
So you went to Ghana and the Cameroons. Did you go anywhere else in Africa?
